transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile customer care, my name is Lewis. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Lewis. I am very frustrated with our Family Share multi-SIM plan. I pay for a shared one-hundred-gigabyte data pool for four family lines, but my teenage daughter's SIM card is suddenly showing zero data allowance, leaving her stranded without maps or messaging when coming home from school!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can investigate the shared data pool allocation, Ian. Let's start with security verification. What is your full name and billing address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Ian Blackwood, 14 Balmoral Road, Aberdeen, AB15 4JU.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is the four-digit security PIN on the account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So what I understand is you have an active Family Share plan with a one-hundred-gigabyte pooled allowance, but your daughter's secondary SIM line is not receiving its allocated data share, is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly. My phone and my wife's phone are using data normally, but my daughter's handset says 'Data plan exhausted'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What is the mobile phone number assigned to your daughter's secondary SIM card?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Her number is 07700 900452.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what handset model is she using?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: She has a Google Pixel 7a.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for a moment while I query the family group provisioning parameters on our mobile gateway.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Ian. I have inspected the Family Share configuration ledger.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What is causing the lock-out on her line?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: During our monthly tariff billing rollover on Sunday, an automated billing flag unlinked line three from the shared pool parent group and placed it on an isolated fallback profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is ridiculous! Why would your computer system randomly detach my daughter's phone from the plan we pay for? She couldn't message us when her bus was delayed!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: System billing scripts re-verify group membership during every billing cycle cutoff.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Well, your script caused a massive safety headache for our family.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously automated database reconciliations occasionally flag lines if usage thresholds align with tariff renewal dates.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you re-attach her line to the one-hundred-gigabyte pool right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I will take direct ownership of this. I am re-associating line ending in 452 with master family group pool FG-88210.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How much shared data remains in our pool for the rest of the month?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your household has eighty-four gigabytes of unused high-speed data remaining out of the one hundred gigabytes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Plenty of data to go around then.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: While we have the account open, would you like to set an individual monthly usage cap on her line, such as twenty gigabytes?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you set individual limits within the shared pool?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, you can specify individual allowance caps so no single family member accidentally consumes the entire pool with heavy downloads.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That would be very sensible. Let's cap her line at twenty-five gigabytes per month.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have applied a twenty-five gigabyte soft cap to line three. She will receive a text warning at eighty percent of that limit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is a brilliant feature. Keeps her mindful of her data usage.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you can adjust or remove that limit anytime inside the My S-Net app under Family Controls.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good to know I have control over that directly from my phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And roaming within Europe is also included from that shared pool at no extra charge.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Very useful for our family holiday in Spain next summer.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have just pushed the Family Share parent link down to the network HLR switch. Bear with me for thirty seconds.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Ian. The network profile has synchronized.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does my daughter need to restart her Google Pixel 7a?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just confirming before we test, the line we updated is 07700 900452, correct?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please have her toggle Airplane Mode on for ten seconds on her Google Pixel, then toggle it off to register on the refreshed cellular profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: She is sitting next to me in the kitchen. She just turned Airplane Mode on... Waiting... Turned it off.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What does her status bar display now?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It shows 'S-Net 5G' with full signal bars!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have her open a browser or YouTube to test data throughput.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: She opened BBC News and played a video... It loaded instantly without buffering!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you also check the My S-Net family portal app on your phone to confirm her line displays under the shared allowance?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Checking the app now... Yes, 'Line 3 - Daughter: Active, accessing 84GB shared pool'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms full data sharing privileges are restored and hardcoded against future billing rollovers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is such a relief. We need her phone to have data when she travels into town.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm your billing contact email on file, it's ian dot blackwood at caledonia dot co dot uk, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's my email.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else with your Family Share plan that I can assist you with today, Ian?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Lewis, as long as her data stays linked, that's everything solved. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Ian, and have a pleasant afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Lewis, goodbye.
